```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)
library(xgboost)


font_add_google("Nanum Gothic", "nanum")
showtext_auto()
```

# Load Dataset

```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/2차 프로젝트/Dataset/train_set_encoded.csv", fileEncoding = "euc-kr")

```

# Modeling

```{r}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
threshold_grid <- seq(from = 0.3, to = 0.7, by = 0.02)
eta_grid <- c(0.01, 0.05, seq(from = 0.1, to = 0.4, by = 0.1))
max_depth_grid <- c(4,6,8,10)
gamma_grid <- c(0,5)
subsample_grid <- c(0.5, 0.8, 1)



for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  
  for(eta in eta_grid){
    for(max_depth in max_depth_grid){
      for(gamma in gamma_grid){
        for(subsample in subsample_grid){
          for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
            CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
            train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
            train_index <- c(1:n) 
            train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
            test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
            test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
            Model <- xgboost(data = as.matrix(train[,-4]), label = train$target, max.depth = max_depth, eta = eta, nthread = 2, nrounds = 2, subsample = subsample, gamma = gamma, objective = "binary:logistic", verbose = 0)
            
            for(threshold in threshold_grid){
              prob_pred <- predict(Model, newdata = as.matrix(test[,-4]))
              pred <- rep(0, test_rowNum)
              pred[prob_pred > threshold] <- 1
              
              # Update Scores
              Accuracy_xGB[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_xGB[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
              FPR_xGB[[seed]] <- c(FPR_xGB[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
              FNR_xGB[[seed]] <- c(FNR_xGB[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
              F1_xGB[[seed]] <- c(F1_xGB[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_xGB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(eta_grid)){
    for(param2 in 1:length(max_depth_grid)){
      for(param3 in 1:length(gamma_grid)){
        for(param4 in 1:length(subsample_grid)){
          for(param5 in 1:length(threshold_grid)){
            CVAccuracy_xGB[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_xGB[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_xGB[[seed]][param5 + (0:(K-1)) * length(threshold_grid) + length(threshold_grid)*K*param4 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*param3 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*param2 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)*param1]))
            CVFPR_xGB[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_xGB[[seed]], mean(FPR_xGB[[seed]][param5 + (0:(K-1)) * length(threshold_grid) + length(threshold_grid)*K*param4 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*param3 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*param2 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)*param1]))
            CVFNR_xGB[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_xGB[[seed]], mean(FNR_xGB[[seed]][param5 + (0:(K-1)) * length(threshold_grid) + length(threshold_grid)*K*param4 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*param3 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*param2 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)*param1]))
            CVF1_xGB[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_xGB[[seed]], mean(F1_xGB[[seed]][param5 + (0:(K-1)) * length(threshold_grid) + length(threshold_grid)*K*param4 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*param3 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*param2 + length(threshold_grid)*K*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)*param1]))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```


# Accuracy

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_xGB)
colnames(xGB_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
xGB_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(xGB_Accuracy)))

xGB_Accuracy <- xGB_Accuracy%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Accuracy")%>%
  mutate(threshold = threshold_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%length((threshold_grid)) + 1])%>%
  mutate(subsample = subsample_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)))%%length(subsample_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(gamma = gamma_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)))%%length(gamma_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(max_depth = max_depth_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)))%%length(max_depth_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(eta = eta_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)))%%length(eta_grid) + 1])
```

## Plot

### eta

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = eta, y = Accuracy, group = eta))
```

### max_depth

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = max_depth, y = Accuracy, group = max_depth))
```

### gamma

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = gamma, y = Accuracy, group = gamma))
```

### subsample

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = subsample, y = Accuracy, group = subsample))
```

## Arrange

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  group_by(Parameter)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy = mean(Accuracy))%>%
  arrange(desc(Accuracy)) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Best 5 Comparison

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy_Best5 <- xGB_Accuracy %>%
  filter(Parameter %in% c("V1397", "V851", "V1356", "V1355", "V1398")) 

xGB_Accuracy_Best5_Mean <- xGB_Accuracy_Best5 %>%
  group_by(Parameter)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy_mean = mean(Accuracy))

ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data = xGB_Accuracy_Best5, aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter, group = Parameter))+
  geom_point(data = xGB_Accuracy_Best5_Mean, aes(x = Accuracy_mean, y = Parameter), color = "red")
```

```{r}
xGB_Accuracy %>%
  filter(Parameter %in% c("V1397"))
```


# F1

```{r}
xGB_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_xGB)
colnames(xGB_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
xGB_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(xGB_F1)))

xGB_F1 <- xGB_F1%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "F1")%>%
  mutate(threshold = threshold_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%length((threshold_grid)) + 1])%>%
  mutate(subsample = subsample_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)))%%length(subsample_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(gamma = gamma_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)))%%length(gamma_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(max_depth = max_depth_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)))%%length(max_depth_grid) + 1])%>%
  mutate(eta = eta_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(threshold_grid)*length(subsample_grid)*length(gamma_grid)*length(max_depth_grid)))%%length(eta_grid) + 1])
```
